authorization: Author correction 2 November2026: all content stays in5.3; make A/B/C reproducible while considering responses in5.1 and5.2; no D; birds appear mainly in B.
status: SUPERSEDED by explicit author instruction: use exploratory Mean NN/LCF/chi regions, not Q.
definition: Q is the mean across seven scenarios of the normalised area under each scenario's median occupancy curve, using the same H-width integration as5.1. A:Q>=0.95; C:Q<=0.05; B:remaining profiles. No structural correlation or bird-fit score enters the rule.
limitations: Thresholds are explicit descriptive conventions, not biological discontinuities. Q measures average response level, not full curve shape; within-region variation, H dependence and scenario contrasts must still be inspected. A can include the lower-right area; no D is created. Bird fits assess model responses and do not identify demographic traits.
